children: NextDC's bull at Jefferies see any additional capital expenditure to resolve power supply issues to its M3 data center as manageable. Analyst Roger Samuel estimates that building an underground transmission line could cost up to 100 million Australian dollars, which is significant but no more than 3% of total development costs. He tells clients in a note that Australia-listed NextDC has already built more than a quarter of the center's capacity. Earnings from the center are more likely to be deferred than lost, Samuel adds. Jefferies has a buy rating and A$17.00 target price on the stock. Shares are in a halt at A$9.18. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
